tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Get the current snapshot of the design document.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the published versions of a design document.

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Apply a CAS-guarded text edit as a new document version.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the head edit; restores the previous version (auditable, files kept).

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Restore a historical version by saving its content as a new head version (append-only; current content is kept as the previous version).

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo an undone edit when it is still the latest version.
